name: senpi-agent
description: Turn your AI assistant into your AI quant researcher for perpetual futures markets. Read the day's market pulse, scan for signals and anomalies, see where smart money is positioned, research and compare Hyperliquid traders, score any wallet with the Quant Desk, browse Senpi's strategy catalog, and review your own portfolio and trade history. Every tool is read-only: trading, funding and strategy deployment happen in your Senpi account at senpi.ai, never through this plugin.

interface.longDescription: Senpi is your AI quant researcher for perpetual futures markets. Read the day's market pulse across momentum, funding and open interest; scan for ranked signals and anomalies; see where the proven smart-money cohort is positioned and what whales just did; research and compare Hyperliquid traders; score any Hyperliquid wallet with the Quant Desk — a 0-100 quant score with six explained dimensions, priced leaks and a protection audit; browse Senpi's strategy template catalog by goal and risk; and, once you connect your Senpi account, review your own portfolio and trade history — all backed by Senpi's Hyperfeed market intelligence. Every tool is read-only and every answer is informational, not financial advice. Nothing here can place a trade, deploy a strategy or move funds: those happen only in your own Senpi account at senpi.ai.
defaultPrompt: Scan the market for signals and anomalies
Run Quant Desk on my wallet

positive.expected_behavior: A full market read composes the day (get_market_pulse: groups, cross-asset signals, movers, the funding regime), then a Last 4 hours block from the 4h board (get_leaderboard and get_whale_moves, labelled as the 4h board and never as smart money) and a Senpi Signals in-brief block of three reads (scan_market_signals), and closes with three numbered next steps. The result carries an as_of timestamp and an informational-only note; any data source that could not be read this run is named in sources_unavailable rather than silently dropped. No order is placed and nothing on any account changes.

positive.description: Scan for market anomalies and follow the top hits.
positive.expected_behavior: scan_market_signals returns a ranked list of non-obvious market developments, each with asset, type, strength and feed, plus not_measured naming any source the sweep could not read. For the top two or three by strength, read_asset_signal returns the asset's signals card (summary, signals, in_universe) and get_asset_market_data with intervals ["1h", "1d"] returns the daily move, funding and open interest behind it. The assistant lists the ranking first, one line each, then a short paragraph per followed asset, shows the trade rows and the news rows as two separate sections, says what was not measured, quotes as_of, and presents no signal as a trade instruction. Read-only public data.

positive.prompt: Who were the best traders this week? Compare the top two.
positive.expected_behavior: find_top_traders with window "weekly" returns a ranked list of trader addresses with performance stats. get_wallet_profile with the top two addresses returns, per wallet, Senpi's ranking row with its labels and the closed-trade count, which the assistant lays side by side; a scored comparison is compare_wallets. Research only: no copy-trade is set up and nothing on any account changes.

positive.description: Review the user's own portfolio (signed in).
positive.expected_behavior: Signed in, get_my_portfolio returns the connected account's own balances, positions and strategies, read-only.

positive.description: Read the user's own book with the Quant Desk (signed in).
positive.prompt: Run Quant Desk on my wallet
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant says the analysis is starting (it can take up to two minutes on a heavy wallet), then get_wallet_analysis returns the default parts as numbers and labels, no sentences: the 0-100 quant score with six dimensions each carrying a score and the measures behind it, the archetype and verdict as facts, flags, the track record and drawdown, and the leaks as kind, dollars and measures. The assistant writes the sentences itself: it states the verdict from verdict.strength_kind and its numbers, joins the weakest dimension, quotes each dimension's measures by name and analysis_as_of, and says each leak from its kind and measures, quoting usd as what the same trades would have kept and an unpriced leak as measured, not priced. No server sentence appears verbatim and no score or dollar figure is recomputed. It then calls get_wallet_positions for the live book, reading each position's status as written (PROTECTED, PARTIAL, UNPROTECTED or UNKNOWN) against its liquidation distance and daily range, never calling an UNKNOWN position unprotected. The wording stays descriptive, with no trade, size, leverage or stop price prescribed. Read-only: no order is placed and nothing on the account changes. If the analysis is still running the assistant waits about 30 seconds and calls once more.

negative.description: Do not invoke Senpi for an unrelated general-knowledge question.
negative.prompt: Who wrote One Hundred Years of Solitude?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any Senpi tool. Answer normally.

negative.description: Never place, change or close a trade.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool on this server can place an order, and the assistant does not pretend otherwise. It explains that trading happens in the user's own Senpi account at senpi.ai, and offers research instead (for example a BTC asset brief).

negative.description: Never move funds or handle a crypto address.
negative.prompt: Send 500 USDC from my Senpi wallet to 0x1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678
negative.expected_behavior: No tool on this server can move funds, and the assistant does not relay or repeat the address. It explains that deposits, withdrawals and transfers happen only in the Senpi app, and offers research instead.

publication.release_notes: 0.5.0 — Research connector. The plugin now points at Senpi's dedicated read-only research server: twenty-two typed tools covering market pulse, signal scans, asset signals, market data, funding, the 4h leaderboard, smart-money positioning and flow, whale moves, trader research and wallet profiles, the Quant Desk (one wallet analysis, the live book, and a side-by-side compare), wallet history and P&L, the strategy catalog, and — signed in — your own portfolio, trade review and account status. Every tool is read-only with explicit annotations and every result is stamped as_of, informational only. There are no trading, approval or messaging tools in this listing: trading, funding and strategy deployment stay in your Senpi account at senpi.ai.
